scope: Passive source/AST/saved-schema review of finite root-owned compile/link recorder; no builder/compiler/module/test/product execution, Git, services or target operations.

checks.candidate_binding: Current full candidate hash inventory must equal source-controls AND actual successful host source_before/source_after, before any compiler command.
checks.fixture_source_binding: Uses qualified actual host first group source list, requires new startup fixture first and unique units. Final source list remains pending until fixture source/host receipt exist.
checks.toolchain: Existing manifest tools.compiler schema; checks all five expected current tool hashes before calls and all after successful link. Each call rechecks compiler.
checks.runtime: Queries seven fixed prior runtime inputs with m68000/msoft-float/nix20 selection; actual resolved paths and hashes must match prior pins, all checked after link.
checks.full_dependency_closure: One compiler -M per recorded host unit, decoded make dependency paths saved with byte size and SHA256 before compile-link; all dependency hashes checked again after link.
checks.compile_link: Exactly one compile/link command combines the same recorded host fixture source units using the fixed flags into retained PTMixedSetupTest.
checks.product: Reads HUNK magic0x3F3 and records product size/hash; never invokes the product. HUNK structural, placement, stack or runtime acceptance is not inferred.
checks.command_bounds: Version1 + runtime7 + per-unit dependencyN + compile/link1; each timeout120s. No retry loop.
checks.first_outcome_retention: Running record/argv/cwd/label saved before each subprocess, raw stdout/stderr retained, elapsed/status/failure saved even on BaseException; first failure aborts later commands and preserves output tree.
checks.final_status: Source-after inventory checked; nonPASS/source-change exits1 after final manifest write.
checks.pre_execution_schema_refusal: Saved native-builder-preparation-v1.json documents root initial saved-schema KeyError; no compiler, builder, test or product was invoked for that observation.

resolved_preseal_observation: Added exact current==controls==host.source_before==host.source_after comparison, preventing a new candidate from consuming stale host PASS.
